text: Provolone Valpadana is a semi-cooked pasta filata of cow's milk that is moulded into shapes from half a kilo to over 100 kg and ripened; the sharp 'piccante' type gets its spicy taste from kid or lamb rennet paste and months of ageing.

steps.note: The curd is stretched in the water and moulded into shapes from 0.5 kg to over 100 kg.
The cheese is left in it for 12–25 days.
The cheese is ripened for up to 2–3 months if dolce, for over 3 if piccante and for over 8 if stagionato, and it may be smoked.
